app.title: MyPDF
app.subtitle: PDF Tools
tool.merge.desc: Combine multiple PDFs into one, in the selected order.
tool.split.desc: Split a PDF by the given page ranges (returned as ZIP).
tool.removePages.desc: Delete specific pages from a PDF.
tool.rotate.desc: Rotate the pages of a PDF.
tool.compress.desc: Reduce PDF file size. Pick a compression level.
tool.flatten.desc: Flatten form fields and annotations into the page (makes PDF non-editable).
tool.repair.desc: Attempt to repair a damaged or corrupted PDF.
tool.watermark.desc: Add a text watermark to every page of a PDF.
tool.addPageNumbers.desc: Stamp page numbers onto each page of a PDF.
tool.addPassword.desc: Encrypt a PDF with an open password.
tool.ocr.desc: Run OCR on a scanned PDF to make text searchable.
tool.extractImages.desc: Extract all embedded images from a PDF (returned as ZIP).
tool.imgToPdf.desc: Combine multiple images into a single PDF.
tool.pdfToWord.desc: Convert a PDF to an editable Word (.docx) document.
tool.officeToPdf.desc: Convert Word / Excel / PowerPoint files to PDF.
hint.stirlingDown: Make sure the Stirling-PDF server (:8080) is running.
